# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest version on the `main` branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for a suspected security vulnerability.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature in this repository's **Security** tab when it is available. Include a clear description, impact assessment, reproduction steps or proof of concept, and any suggested mitigation.

If private reporting is unavailable, contact a project maintainer through the official Everglow Discord server and ask for a private reporting channel. Please give maintainers reasonable time to investigate and release a fix before sharing details publicly.

## Scope

This policy covers the website source code, its deployment workflows, and project-managed infrastructure. Third-party services and browser extensions are outside this repository's direct control, though reports that affect visitors are still welcome.
